summary: Time-bound Kafka-based audit replay with consumer-lag watermarks and cryptographic manifest for PCI QSA
description: CardioPay's PCI QSA has requested an ordered, time-bound replay of audit events for the window 2025-12-01 to 2026-01-15, with explicit consumer-lag watermarks, per-event HMAC proofs, and an attested manifest (RFC3161 timestamps). They require a self-contained evidence package that demonstrates event ordering, delivery receipts, and tamper-evidence for the specified timeframe. Customer specifically expects a Kafka-backed audit replay (topic: audit.events) with offsets, partition-level watermarks, and checksums, plus a downloadable signed bundle and verification instructions for the auditor.
steps_to_reproduce: Support to extract offsets and snapshots from Kafka topic 'audit.events' across partitions
Generate per-event HMAC using Redwood's signing service and produce manifest with RFC3161 timestamps
Package events (JSONL) + manifest + verification script + checksums into a zip and upload to Azure Blob with SAS URL
Provide verification instructions and sample verification run output to customer and QSA

comments: 2026-03-05 - Alex Chen: Opened ticket after customer sent QSA checklist in email. QSA needs ordered replay + proof of non-repudiation for a two-month window. Assigned to on-call for audit exports.

2026-03-06 - Priya Kumar: Acknowledged. Confirmed topic name and time window with customer via email. Asked whether they require per-tenant filtering (they do; CardioPay uses tenant_id in event headers).

2026-03-08 - SRE (Miguel Torres): Noted we will need to snapshot consumer offsets across 12 partitions and run an extraction job in a secured VPC to avoid cross-tenant leakage. Created ephemeral consumer group 'audit-replay-customer-sup-773900'.

2026-03-10 - Security (Jenna Park): Confirmed HSM-signed manifest is acceptable. Will issue RFC3161 timestamp from internal TSA and co-sign manifest. Need KMS access approval from customer for per-event HMAC key binding.

2026-03-11 - Priya Kumar: Extraction run scheduled for 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC (low traffic window). Will produce signed bundle and upload to customer's Azure container with SAS link. Requested auditor contact for direct verification if needed.

2026-03-12 - Alex Chen: Uploaded evidence bundle to Azure and shared SAS link with customer (expiration 7 days). Included verification script (sha256 checksums, signature verification steps) and a short runbook. Awaiting QSA confirmation of receipt and acceptance.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: QSA requires proof that the audit stream is complete and unmodified for the requested window; extraction must include offsets, checksums, and signed manifest to prove chain-of-custody.

Found that some older events in partition 7 had been compacted by retention policy; however, full event payloads for requested window are present in cold storage (archived blobs) and were retrievable.
Confirmed per-tenant filter available via event header 'tenant_id' - extraction job applied include/exclude filter for CardioPay tenant hash.
Confirmed signing path: events -> HMAC(key=redwood/audit-signing/cardio) -> manifest. KMS policy allowed customer to bind audit key to their KMS alias for auditor verification.
resolution: Workaround/fix: Produced a self-contained evidence bundle (sup-773900-audit-replay-20260312.zip) containing: partitioned JSONL event files, per-event HMAC file, signed RFC3161 manifest, README verification steps, and sha256 checksums.

Delivery: Uploaded to customer's Azure container 'cardio-evidence' and provided a SAS link (valid 7 days). Also provided a transient support VM (bastion) with read-only access to run verification scripts with QSA (pre-approved by customer).
Rollout notes: No changes required to production ingestion. Extraction was run as a read-only Kafka consumer on an ephemeral consumer group; retention settings untouched.

Follow-up items: 1) Add a runbook template for PCI QSA replay requests (task INT-112233). 2) Offer customer scheduled monthly snapshots (if they opt-in) and a long-term evidence artifact retention add-on. 3) Confirm QSA sign-off and close ticket.
